workflow: A low-level runtime encodes signed state values into a packed representation.
Some valid state values are negative.
The encoding left-shifts the value before converting it to an unsigned representation.
The signed negative shift invokes undefined behavior, causing runtime diagnostics during ordinary execution.
summary: Negative signed value is shifted before packed-state encoding
decision_reason: The failure workflow materially matches the existing cluster: valid negative state is left-shifted while still signed, triggering undefined behavior during encoding.
